hc.guide1.title: Sign in securely
hc.guide1.body: Register your details, verify your email and complete the MFA code. Authentication and email delivery are currently for demonstration only.
hc.guide2.title: Prepare your first trade
hc.guide2.body: Look up a NYSE or NASDAQ stock. Choose buy or sell, quantity, and a market or limit order. Review the amounts before confirming.
hc.guide3.title: Follow every step
hc.guide3.body: Review the details of the demo trades saved in this browser.
hc.guide4.title: Understand your results
hc.guide4.body: Check positions and reports by period. The estimated 2% Acciones UD commission is shown separately from the provider's charges.
hc.a1: Everything runs in this browser with illustrative prices and virtual funds. It does not connect to financial providers.
hc.q2: Why don't prices or balances appear?
hc.a2: Open the demo or complete sign-up to get virtual funds. Prices are fixed examples with no real-time updates.
hc.q3: What happens if the market is closed?
hc.a3: The local demo is available at any time. Illustrative prices do not change when exchanges open or close.
hc.q4: Do funding and protective orders work?
hc.a4: Funds are added to the local virtual balance. Protective orders are previews: you can review their forms without sending trades.
hc.q5: Are commissions or Premium charged yet?
hc.a5: The 2% commission is an estimate. Subscriptions and alerts are shown as design views; no charges are made.
